order.update: GrounderFBBIK.Update sets firstSolve and clamps weight. OnSolverUpdate runs once per frame as the last OnPreUpdate subscriber: Grounding.Update, pelvis position += Pelvis.IKOffset*weight, SetLegIK left then right, then the spine offset.
order.grounding: Clamp settings; root ray; each Leg.Process; Pelvis.Process(-max(IKOffset)*lowerPelvisWeight, -min(IKOffset)*liftPelvisWeight, any leg grounded).
order.leg: Elapsed Time.time; flattened foot velocity; heel, forward and side rays; plane normal turned toward the hit plane at most maxFootRotationAngle radians; height is the root height above the plane, capped by the heel hit; IKOffset moves by LerpValue then Lerp toward the clamped height; clamp by leg height; foot rotation Slerp; IKPosition = foot - up*IKOffset.
order.pelvis: heightOffset Lerp toward the summed target, then minus root rise * pelvisDamper * damperF; damperF LerpValue toward grounded at 1 up, 10 down.
order.spine: spineOffset Lerp toward the summed leg bend vectors * weight * spineBend at deltaTime*spineSpeed; each listed effector gets spineOffset*horizontalWeight + root.up*|spineOffset|*verticalWeight.

scope: Disconnected grounding arithmetic for the serialized female settings. Not a host integration, not a collision model and not a pose claim.
limitations: Metadata tokens are build-local and only meaningful with the stated artifact SHA-256 and MVID.
CIL is read from file bytes; no JIT, floating-point or engine behavior is observed.
Physics.Raycast and the engine Quaternion/Vector3 internal calls are native and absent from this managed evidence.
Nested types carry bare names in the inventory; declaring_type_token and type_names identify them.
Static method bodies do not establish collision layers, colliders or what a ray hits at runtime.
Rays are a caller callback; the original casts against Unity colliders on the serialized layers.
Quaternion FromToRotation/Slerp and Vector3 RotateTowards are conventional adapters in C; no engine or Mono arithmetic was executed.
Only rotateSolver off with quality Simple is implemented, as serialized; Fastest and Best are refused.
The observed tutorial session was on flat ground, where the grounder contributes under a millimetre; no uneven-ground comparison exists.
